info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Petadoption Pets Fosters-v1-spec
info.description: The Foster Pet Listing API provides users with access to a comprehensive list of pets available for fostering through the pet adoption platform. This endpoint is designed for potential foster families seeking to support animal welfare by temporarily housing pets in need. Developers can utilize this API to integrate listing features within applications, allowing users to explore various pets and their details. Typical consumers include animal shelters, foster care coordinators, and individuals interested in fostering pets.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of available pets for fostering.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current list of pets that are available for fostering through the system. The response will include details about each pet, including their age, breed, and special needs. Ideal for prospective foster families looking to help animals in need.
